SQLite is part of 3 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2025.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (2) and [Web](@/projects/web.md) (1).

Most recently: [korczis.gitlab.io](@/work/korczis-gitlab-io.md); [gooddata\_rails\_app](@/work/gooddata-rails-app.md): GoodData as Rails Application; [apollo-crawler](@/work/apollo-crawler.md).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses SQLite: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links SQLite to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
